messages:
anya: Quick follow-up from today's RFC review — thinking about supporting "trickle streaming" (partial-token flush) + retries. Short notes.

mike: +1 we need clear semantics. Are we retrying mid-stream or only on final failure? Mid-stream retry seems messy.

sofia: Mid-stream retry means dedupe + idempotency. Can't re-send earlier tokens. We could only allow retry on handshake/connection failure before first chunk sent.

raj: Related: we have resume token idea for continued streams vs full retry. Resume works for transient infra failures, not app-level changes (model version/rollout).

lin: Also watch billing: replays + hedging double-charge risk. Customers will ask.

anya: Proposal: three-tier policy: (1) Resume (token-based) for conn failures within a short window, (2) Hedging for slow upstreams (speculative second request) but only before any token emitted, (3) Abort-and-retry only as last resort. Keep max full-retries low.

mike: Suggest increase resume_window to 15s for long-turn convs.

sofia: Tradeoff: larger window increases KV cache retention and billing complexity. Also increases surface for signed-token replay.

anya: UX: bubble retry attempts to clients via headers/events so apps can handle duplicates. Idea: `x-redwood-retry: resumed|hedged|none` and an optional `x-redwood-resume-token` handshake.

raj: Needs tests: simulate partial-token emission + midstream conn drop, expect resume token handshake to continue from last acked offset. Also test model-variant rollout where resume should be disallowed.

anya: Example config snippet for the edge runtime: 

```json
{
  "streaming": {
    "resume_window_s": 8,
    "hedge_before_first_byte_ms": 250,
    "max_retries_on_error": 1,
    "retry_policy": "resume|hedge|none"
  }
}
```

lin: Also consider per-route override: `retryPolicy: none|resume|hedge` so enterprises can opt out for side-effectful flows (webhooks, payments).

sofia: Action items: add state machine for resume handshake + token signing, define cache TTL implications, and billing semantics for hedged/duplicated tokens.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: r/edge-proxy-streaming-2026-03-22

lin: Security: tag @security for audit + token signing.

security: noted — require KMS-backed resume token signing and an expiration claim. Also include replay detection server-side (nonce + small window).

mike: +1 on KMS signing. Also we should document observable signals: `retry.type`, `retry.count`, `resume.offset`.

anya: I'll draft an RFC addendum with a simple state machine and sequence diagrams. Raj and Mike to review.

sofia: small nit — bikeshed header name. I prefer `x-rw-stream-retry` to keep header short.

anya: prefer `x-redwood-stream-retry` for clarity. Bikeshed later.

lin: final ask: include explicit metric names and billing counters in the doc (hedged_tokens, resumed_tokens, retried_requests).

mike: Good call. Also include a chaos test for simultaneous token replay across multiple edge pods.

anya: Thanks all. Action: Sofia drafts addendum, Raj + Mike review, Security to verify signing requirements, I'll schedule a quick sync tomorrow 10:00 if needed. :thumbsup:

sofia: I'll start the draft this afternoon.

raj: leaving notes in the RFC PR.

anya: Closing thread for now.
